description_en: Grants permissions to the service account of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 调用GrantOperatorPermission接口为集群服务账号授权
kebab_example: aliyun adb grant-operator-permission --db-cluster-id am-bp1565u55p320000 --expired-time 2022-11-30T00:00:00Z --privileges Control --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GrantOperatorPermission

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查询集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The expiration time of the service account permissions. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 服务账号权限过期时间。UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: expired_time

parameters.help_en:
The name of the permissions. Valid values:

Control: configuration permissions. The service account is granted permissions to query and modify cluster configurations.
Data: data permissions. The service account is granted permissions to query schemas, indexes, and SQL statements
parameters.help_zh:
权限名称。取值说明：
Control：配置权限，查看和修改集群配置。
Data：数据权限，查看表结构、索引和SQL
parameters.name: privileges
